description.text:
The runner-up deck of the 15 and up division at the 2006 World Championships, built on Eevee and each of its Pokémon-ex evolutions: Espeon ex, Flareon ex, Jolteon ex, Vaporeon ex and Umbreon ex. The 2006 World Championships were held at the Hilton Anaheim in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2006.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2006 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
